Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 cites exactly one physical page of the private snapshot of the Washington Driver Guide, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: high for the parking, transporting and maritime facts, each restated from one explicit list item or paragraph; nothing was taken from memory, from a non-issuer source, or from the parking diagrams.
Precision rule: every parking distance, the curb gap, the child age thresholds, the emergency zone speed rules and the beach speed limit are kept exactly as printed inside cited fact blocks in C and C2, with the wording paraphrased so that no learner line copies the guide.
Accuracy flags: the perpendicular, angled, parallel and hill parking pictures were read only through their numbered step text, so nothing drawn in them was used, and ferry fares and schedules are not printed (the guide points to the state transportation website), so none are asserted (verify — sec11-D-FLAG).
Stability: the guide is a single published revision and states it may lag new legislation, so any rule that a future law changes must be re-read from the current edition before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
